title: The Morning Round
summary: Saltmouth's mail run: two drops around town — the water tower crew and the moorage mast. Light parcels, gossip-grade cargo, decent warm-up money.

objectives.label: Collect the mail bag at the job board
Drop mail at the water tower
Drop mail at the moorage mast

offer.text: Mail run. The tower crew complain if they're left out of the gossip loop, and the moorage crew complain regardless. Democracy in action.

accept.text: Light bag, nothing fragile, nothing hums. Refreshingly normal, honestly.

complete.text: Both drops done. The tower crew says the water tastes like victory today. That's rust, but I didn't say so.
Counted, logged, paid. You see, courier? A job that behaves — cherish it.
